title: Inspect operand values and Boolean conversions
description: You read stored expression results, then inspect their Boolean conversions.

steps.description: You store expression labels beside their evaluated results. The cases include and and or expressions with Boolean, numeric, and string operands.
You print each stored value with its Python type. repr formatting keeps string quotes visible.

steps.question: Does the second loop evaluate the labeled expression again?
steps.answer: It reads each stored value and applies bool(value). The label is text used for printing.

steps.description: You print Boolean conversions of the same stored results. The False and 'hello' row remains False in the recorded output.
You reach the Boolean-only display loop. Its output contains True or False in place of the stored operand values.
